## India Threatens to Revoke Meta's Safe Harbor Protections After Modi-Related Post Restriction

India is a top-tier growth market for Meta; safe harbor revocation would fundamentally alter content moderation obligations and legal exposure there. More broadly, this signals rising willingness by large democracies to use regulatory leverage over US platform content decisions—a systemic risk worth tracking.

- Indian authorities are reportedly threatening to revoke Meta's safe harbor protections following Meta's restriction of a post related to Prime Minister Modi.
- Loss of safe harbor would expose Meta to direct platform liability for user-generated content in one of its largest user markets.
- The action reflects escalating geopolitical and regulatory risk for US platforms operating in India.
- No specific regulatory ruling, timeline, or formal proceeding has been confirmed in the headline.
